title: Fix migration reassembly + rebuild-containment repair + audit + release
description:
Hotfix phase. Tasks:
T1 — Fix migrateToGlobalSequence (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:283-287): reassemble `numberedTasks` into `tasksByPhase` by `task.phaseId` (fallback to the paired phase from allTasks if phaseId empty), not by positional index. Preserve numbering (createdAt sort) + phase task order (taskIds).
T2 — Add `rebuildContainment()` to PlanStore (plan-core): load all phases, group every task by its own `task.phaseId`, rewrite each phase file's `tasks`+`taskIds` from the grouped set (preserve taskIds order, append orphans by number). Expose via plan_repair in pi-adapter + plan-mcp (action 'rebuild-containment' or fold into default repair). Deterministic, lossless, idempotent.
T3 — Audit other projects: scan known .planner dirs for (a) legacy per-phase numbering (duplicate task numbers across phases) AND (b) task.phaseId != file phase.id mismatch. Report which are corrupted.
T4 — Build + check + release next.7 (pnpm release:next). User authorized deploy.

Behaviors to preserve: migration idempotency; deterministic numbering; phase task order.

tasks.title: fix-migration-task-001-reassemble-by-phaseid
tasks.description:
Fix the index-mismatch bug in migrateToGlobalSequence (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:283-287). Current: `numberedTasks[i]` (sorted by createdAt) paired with `allTasks[i]!.phase.id` (phase-iteration order) → task filed in wrong phase. Fix: reassemble by `task.phaseId` (source of truth). Add fallback to the paired phase (from allTasks) if phaseId is empty. Preserve: numbering (createdAt sort), phase task order (taskIds order), idempotency (no-op when numbers already global).

---
**Completion summary:**
Fixed migrateToGlobalSequence index-mismatch bug (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:281-294). Was: `numberedTasks[i]` (sorted by createdAt) paired with `allTasks[i]!.phase.id` (phase-iteration order) → task filed in wrong phase. Now: reassemble by `task.phaseId` (source of truth), with fallback to the phase the task was loaded from (phaseIdByTaskId map) when phaseId is empty/stale or dangles. Guard: only use t.phaseId when it points to a real phase (newPhaseIds set). Preserves: numbering (createdAt sort), phase task order (taskIds), idempotency (no-op when numbers already global).

Verified: pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build clean. Smoke test on heca .planner data (359 tasks, 85 phases): reassemble-by-phaseId places 359/359 correctly, 0 misplaced, numbers unique. NOTE: this fix prevents FUTURE corruption but does NOT heal heca (migration is idempotent on numbers → won't re-run on already-corrupted heca). Heal is T2 (rebuildContainment).

tasks.title: fix-migration-task-002-rebuild-containment-repair
tasks.description:
Add rebuildContainment() to PlanStore (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts): load all phases, flatten all tasks, group by task.phaseId, rewrite each phase file's tasks+taskIds from the grouped set (preserve existing taskIds order; append orphan tasks by number). Idempotent + lossless. Expose via plan_repair in pi-adapter (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts) + plan-mcp (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts) — either as a 'rebuild-containment' action or folded into the default repair flow. This heals projects corrupted by the migration bug.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added rebuildContainment() to PlanStore (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, after ensureStructureOrdering). Groups every task by its own task.phaseId (fallback to the phase file it was loaded from when phaseId is empty/stale/dangling), preserves each phase's existing taskIds order, appends orphan tasks by number, writes a phase file only when its task set actually changed. Lossless + idempotent.

Folded into repair() (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1190) — /planner repair now heals corrupted plans automatically. Added containment:{changed,tasks,orphan} to the repair() return type.

Exposed in both adapters:
- pi-adapter plan_repair (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:2547): updated description + reports containment line.
- plan-mcp planner-repair (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:205): updated description + reports containment in the text response.

Verified: pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean. Smoke test on a COPY of heca .planner: BEFORE 350/359 mismatched → rebuildContainment {changed:81, tasks:359, orphan:0} → AFTER 0/359 mismatched. Idempotent re-run {changed:0}. Full heal confirmed.

tasks.title: fix-migration-task-003-audit-corruption
tasks.description:
Audit other projects for the same corruption. Scan known .planner dirs (heca, agent-plan, + any others under ~/projects) for: (a) legacy per-phase numbering (duplicate task numbers across phases → migration would run), AND (b) task.phaseId != file phase.id mismatch (containment already corrupted). Report which projects are corrupted + counts.

---
**Completion summary:**
Audited all .planner dirs under ~/projects (5 found):
- heca: 85 phases, 359 tasks, 350 mismatched → CORRUPTED (already loaded next.5).
- agent-plan: 21 phases, 89 tasks, 0 mismatched, taskDupes=true → legacy-numbering, migration would run + corrupt on next load with next.5/next.6.
- agent-plan-test2: 304 phases, 1008 tasks, 0 mismatched, taskDupes=true → legacy-numbering, AT RISK (large plan).
- hype/public-site-monorepo: 22 phases, 120 tasks, 0 mismatched, taskDupes=true → legacy-numbering, AT RISK.
- tests: 1 phase, 1 task, clean.

Conclusion: 3 projects (agent-plan, agent-plan-test2, hype) are at risk — DO NOT load them with next.5/next.6 before installing next.7 (the fix). Once next.7 is installed, migrateToGlobalSequence reassembles by task.phaseId (safe). heca is the only already-corrupted project; /planner repair (next.7) heals it.

tasks.title: fix-migration-task-004-build-release
tasks.description:
Build (pnpm -r build) + type-check (pnpm check) clean. Then release next.7 via pnpm release:next (user authorized deploy). Verify publish.yml succeeds + all packages on npm @next as next.7.

---
**Completion summary:**
Committed hotfix (5c50635) on `next` + released 0.2.19-next.7. pnpm release:next bumped all 5 packages, pushed, publish.yml completed successfully (1m10s). Verified on npm: @agent-plan/core, @agent-plan/mcp, @agent-plan/server, @agent-plan/pi-adapter all at 0.2.19-next.7 under dist-tag `next`.

End-to-end verification with the PUBLISHED @agent-plan/core@0.2.19-next.7 on a heca .planner copy: BEFORE 350/359 mismatched → repair() {containment:{changed:81,tasks:359,orphan:0}} → AFTER 0/359 mismatched. The published package heals heca.

User next steps: (1) install next.7 in Pi (pi install npm:@agent-plan/pi-adapter), (2) run /planner repair on heca to heal, (3) the 3 at-risk projects (agent-plan, agent-plan-test2, hype) are safe to load with next.7 — the migration is fixed.
